findings.claim: The generated MCP schema permits zero timeout/output values even though the runtime rejects them, so the checked contract does not match the tool behavior.
findings.evidence: Implementation rejects zero in `crates/prometheus-exec/src/mcp.rs` hunk: `if params.timeout_ms == 0 || params.output_mb == 0 { return Err("timeoutMs and outputMb must be non-zero".into()); }`; generated schema hunk declares `"timeoutMs": { ... "minimum": 0 ... }` and `"outputMb": { ... "minimum": 0 ... }`; acceptance 1.3 requires generated/drift-checked MCP schemas and `execution-mcp-surface` requires tool schemas to be checked against canonical execution contracts.
findings.suggested_fix: Add schema validation annotations or custom schema generation so `timeoutMs` and `outputMb` have `minimum: 1`, then regenerate `docs/reference/api/prometheus-exec.mcp.json`.
